notes: Prefers the Cloudflare-hosted release metadata mirror when checking for updates, while keeping the website and GitHub endpoints as fallbacks.
Publishes the same release metadata through the DingDong Worker with no-cache headers so update checks can recover from an unavailable source.
Adapts unbacked macOS menu-bar mascot artwork to the current light or dark appearance and refreshes immediately when the appearance changes.
Keeps reminder artwork white over its colored background, including both animation frames.
Keeps Intel macOS and Windows packages marked as beta.
